top_posts.text:
I see a lot of people complaining about Temu, but some of you don’t read. 

You see a cheap product and immediately place an order without reading the description to understand exactly what you’re buying.

Then the package arrives and it’s “What I ordered vs what I got.”

It’s the same thing with Chinese apps like 1688 and Pinduoduo. Read the product description properly. Check the pictures, specifications and reviews. See what other people who bought from the supplier are saying.

A lot of these complaints can be avoided if people simply READ before ordering.

Please, read the damn description. 🤦🏽‍♀️🤦🏽‍♀️🤦🏽‍♀️

top_posts.translation_zh:
我看到很多人在抱怨 Temu，但你们有些人不阅读。

你们看到一个便宜商品，就立刻下单，根本不看描述来准确了解自己买的是什么。

然后包裹到了，就变成“我下单的东西 vs 我收到的东西”。

像 1688 和 Pinduoduo 这样的中国 app 也是同样的情况。好好阅读商品描述。查看图片、规格和评价。看看其他从这个供应商购买的人怎么说。

如果人们在下单前只是先阅读，很多这类抱怨都可以避免。

拜托，看看该死的描述吧。🤦🏽‍♀️🤦🏽‍♀️🤦🏽‍♀️
